5. For sparse colored diagonal markers on a zero field, identify the invariant of their parallel lines: constant row−column for down-right diagonals, or row+column for down-left diagonals. Then color every cell from its phase, rather than preserving only the sparse markers. Verify several cells against each demonstrated line and ensure the resulting output reproduces every demo. Do not assume the marker positions alone give every residue's color; use output examples to establish the complete mapping.
